old: Part of the problem is that the Buddha, or those who recorded him, left the pieces in different drawers. Ud 1.10 points to direct sensations as the gateway; SN 12.44 gives the contact chain building “the world”; SN 12.67 has consciousness and mind-and-body leaning together like two bundles of reeds – pull either away and the other falls, like Jenga.
new: Part of the problem is that the Buddha (or the people writing his words down) stored the pieces of the puzzle in different drawers. For instance, he talks about direct sensations as the gateway in Ud 1.10, but explains how contact creates “the world” in a chain in SN 12.44. He talks about how consciousness and mind-and-body are like two bundles of reeds that lean against each other (remove one and the other falls down, Jenga!) in SN 12.67.
